posts: Three taps to approve a transaction, then a silent spinner for six seconds. Users think the app froze and start double-clicking. Just show me the tx hash and a status line, please. #wallets #near

Chain signatures keep getting pitched as magic, but nobody mentions the multi-second MPC round trip. Bake an honest 'signing in progress…' state into your UI or users will retry and blame the chain. #chainsignatures #wallets
